.cargo: Cargo configuration discovered by root-invoked Cargo and maturin.
.github: GitHub workflows, repository automation, policy and ownership discovery.
.gitignore: Git ignore rules for repository worktrees.
AGENTS.md: Root instructions discovered by coding agents.
LICENSE: Repository license consumed by hosting and package builds.
Makefile: Root entry points for workspace development and testing.
README.md: Repository overview consumed by hosting and package builds.
litellm: Python SDK and consolidated project sources.
model_prices_and_context_window.json: Published model metadata consumed by the SDK and external readers.
policy_templates.json: Published policy templates retained at their existing root URL.
provider_endpoints_support.json: Published provider endpoint metadata retained at its existing root URL.
pyproject.toml: Root Python package manifest and workspace configuration.
rust-toolchain.toml: Toolchain selection discovered by root-invoked Cargo and maturin.
tests: Repository-wide test suites and test infrastructure.
uv.lock: Locked dependency graph for the root Python workspace.
